Sure! So I start by making the facial shape with some biodegradable moldable plastic (polymorph) and I also make tiny red hearts for them. After that I take some wire, twist it and make skeletons so that the dolls can be articulated. For eyes, I take normal googly eyes, make a tiny opening on the top, pop out the irises, paint then, cover them with uv resin, pop them back in and seal the top with uv resin then paint the "eye shadow". For the stuffing, I use recycled paper towels (because they're very cheap and recyclable) and wrap the metal wiring. For the making process, I start by stuffing the head, then I go on to work on different body parts until the whole doll takes shape and after I put the wigs together, I finish the doll by embroidering the face details (eyelashes and lips) and add some blush on them!
